# OnePointer 0.4.0
## 简体中文
- 新增菜单栏模式：隐藏 Dock 和 ⌘⇥ 图标，在屏幕顶部菜单栏随时找回 OnePointer。 - 设置侧栏新增“在后台运行”和“退出 OnePointer”，清楚区分收起窗口和完全退出。 - 菜单栏可立即聚焦指针、开关持续高亮、打开设置、检查更新和退出。 - 修复关闭或最小化设置后重新打开 App 时，窗口无法正常恢复的问题。 - 开机启动安静地在后台运行，不再弹出设置窗口。 - 修复快速聚焦快捷键开关慢一拍的问题，避免权限监听失败时反复重试。 - 演示帧率切换立即生效。
菜单栏模式默认关闭；点击“在后台运行”即可启用。关闭窗口会继续运行；点击 “退出 OnePointer”或在设置窗口按 ⌘Q 可完全退出。
感谢 @OpenAndrus 在 PR #1 中贡献菜单栏模式和快捷键修复。
## English
- Optional menu-bar mode hides OnePointer from the Dock and ⌘⇥ while keeping it available at the top of the screen. - Clear “Run in Background” and “Quit OnePointer” sidebar actions. - Focus the pointer, toggle persistent highlighting, open Settings, check for updates, and quit directly from the menu bar. - Reopening the app restores closed or minimized Settings reliably. - Launch at login runs quietly without opening Settings. - Quick-focus switches take effect immediately; failed input listeners no longer trigger recursive authorization refreshes. - Presentation frame-rate changes apply immediately.
Menu-bar mode is off by default. Choose “Run in Background” to enable it. Closing Settings keeps the app running; choose Quit or press ⌘Q in Settings to stop it.
Thanks to @OpenAndrus for the menu-bar mode and shortcut fixes in PR #1.

# OnePointer 0.3.1
首次授权流程现在更清楚，也不再需要手动寻找 App。
- 首次启动时先说明为什么双击快捷手势需要“输入监控” - 点击“继续并授权”后，由 macOS 将 OnePointer 加入权限列表 - 用户只需打开 OnePointer 右侧开关，不再需要点击 `+` 手动添加 - 可以选择“暂不授权”，不影响立即聚焦和持续高亮 - 权限区域会根据当前状态只显示一个清晰的下一步操作
---
The first-run permission flow is now clearer and no longer asks people to find the app manually.
- Explains why the double-tap gesture needs Input Monitoring before requesting it - Uses the macOS HID authorization flow to add OnePointer to the permission list - Users only need to turn on the OnePointer switch instead of adding it with `+` - “Not Now” keeps Focus Now and persistent highlighting available - The permission area shows one clear next action for the current state

# OnePointer 0.3.0
设置界面经过重新设计，让快速聚焦与持续高亮都更容易找到和使用。
- 只保留“快速聚焦”和“持续高亮”两个清晰入口 - 持续高亮改为醒目的全宽主按钮，可一键开启或关闭 - 所有设置直接展示，不再折叠“高级设置” - 开机启动、检查更新、帧率和重置整合到快速聚焦页 - 全新 App 图标更明确地表达鼠标指针与聚焦功能 - 新增 OneApps.Studio 更多实用 App 入口
---
The settings window has been redesigned to make both quick focus and persistent highlighting easier to find and use.
- Two clear destinations: Quick Focus and Persistent Highlight - A prominent full-width control enables or disables persistent highlighting - All settings stay visible without a collapsed advanced section - Launch at login, updates, frame rate, and reset now live on the Quick Focus page - A refreshed app icon clearly communicates pointer focus - A new link helps users discover more apps from OneApps.Studio
